key_insight: PEPRino uses response-theory-based pulse shaping to generate high-fidelity quantum control protocols without gradients or hyperparameter tuning.
engineering_relevance: This offers a more stable and potentially faster optimization path for compiling multi-qubit gates, especially in high-dimensional quantum control settings.
method: Projects control pulses using response functions to infinite nonlinear order.
Evaluates the infinite-order landscape efficiently via resummation from first- and second-order response functions.
Applies the method to 2-qubit and 3-qubit Quantum Fourier Transform implementations.
evidence_signal: In the 2-qubit benchmark against CRAB with Nelder-Mead, PEPRino showed faster convergence in both iteration count and computational time.
watch_item: The abstract reports benchmark gains on limited QFT test cases, so broader scalability and hardware robustness still need validation.
paper_title: Pulse engineering via projection of response functions at infinite nonlinear order
